title: Daiwa SB Investments Ltd. Sells 36,740 Shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Posted by Sebastian Weber on Apr 19th, 2018 // No Comments 
Daiwa SB Investments Ltd. lessened its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 53.2% during the 4th quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 32,260 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 36,740 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up about 1.4% of Daiwa SB Investments Ltd.’s portfolio, making the stock its 25th biggest position. Daiwa SB Investments Ltd.’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,459,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. 
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Beach Investment Management LLC. grew its position in shares of Apple by 1,517.7% during the 2nd quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,651,000 after acquiring an additional 167,099 shares during the period. Crescent Grove Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in Apple in the 2nd quarter worth about $2,817,000. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC boosted its holdings in Apple by 8,719.3% in the 2nd quarter. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC now owns 384,344 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $55,353,000 after buying an additional 379,986 shares during the last quarter. First Capital Advisors Group LLC. boosted its holdings in Apple by 1.6% in the 2nd quarter. First Capital Advisors Group LLC. now owns 16,639 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,396,000 after buying an additional 255 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Teacher Retirement System of Texas boosted its holdings in Apple by 0.7% in the 2nd quarter. Teacher Retirement System of Texas now owns 3,279,408 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $472,300,000 after buying an additional 24,352 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of AAPL stock traded down $0.40 during trading hours on Wednesday, hitting $177.84. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 20,538,125 shares, compared to its average volume of 35,979,844. The firm has a market capitalization of $892,113.06, a PE ratio of 19.31, a P/E/G ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.25. Apple has a twelve month low of $140.45 and a twelve month high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter last year, the business earned $3.36 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year. 
AAPL has been the topic of a number of research reports. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Tuesday, December 19th. Instinet lowered shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and set a $175.00 price target on the stock. in a research report on Tuesday, December 19th. BMO Capital Markets reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $199.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 20th. Loop Capital reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, December 22nd. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, December 26th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $203.21. 
In other Apple news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at this link . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here .
